help.text:
Snake Media

/request <title> — request a movie or show.
/recommend — find something to watch.
/status — My requests, progress and expiry.

Choose a button below. More details: Seasons & expiry or /serverstatus.

request.text:
Send /request followed by a title, or a plain media request.
Example: /request The Matrix from 1999

Review the poster before confirming. For TV, choose the season(s) you want.

expiry.text:
TV: choose Latest season, All seasons or a specific season, then Confirm. New episodes and future regular seasons are monitored.

Movies: 7 days after import. TV: 30 days per episode after import. Watching can shorten expiry to 7 days; it never extends it.

Use /extend or /keep to choose an existing request. Download cards also have expiry buttons. Include "keep for 14 days" or "keep permanently" in a new request to change its default.
